headline: EC: Presidential election on August 20
summary: The Election Commission has announced the schedule for the presidential election, with polling scheduled for August 20.
details: The Election Commission (EC) has announced that the presidential election will be held on August 20, with polling scheduled from 2:00pm to 5:00pm.
Nomination papers will be submitted on August 13 between 10:00am and 4:00pm, with the scrutiny of nomination papers beginning at 10:00am on August 16.
EC Senior Secretary Akhtar Ahmed announced the schedule this afternoon at the commission's headquarters in Agargaon, Dhaka.
The schedule was announced in accordance with the Presidential Election Act, 1991, following consultations between the chief election commissioner (CEC) and the Speaker of parliament.
The EC has received the electoral roll comprising the 349 members of parliament from the Parliament Secretariat for the presidential election.
The commission held a meeting to finalise preparations ahead of the election and stated that remaining administrative procedures will be completed in line with the announced schedule.
caption:

The schedule was announced in accordance with the Presidential Election Act, 1991, following consultations between the chief election commissioner (CEC) and the Speaker of parliament.

headline: Measles outbreak: Death toll reaches 860 as six die in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles cases and fatalities, with hundreds of children affected.
details: Six people died within 24 hours due to measles symptoms, according to a report by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released Thursday afternoon.
During the same period, 818 more people were infected with measles or showed symptoms of the disease.
Since March 15, a total of 764 children have died from measles symptoms, while 96 deaths have been confirmed cases of measles.
On Wednesday, August 5, five children died in a single day, and 1,083 new infections were reported.
caption:
